FULL TEXT:
Government of Goa
GOA STATE MENTAL HEALTH AUTHORITY
INSTITUTE OF PSYCHIATRY AND HUMAN BEHAVIOUR
ADVERTISEMENT
Goa State Mental Health Authority, Government of Goa, invites applications from eligible
individuals/organizations for nomination as non-official members to be on Goa State Mental Health
Authority (panel) which is to be constituted under the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017.
The below given categories of post are to be filled under section 45 & sub-section (1) of Section 46 of
the Goa mental healthcare Act 2017:
Sr.
No.
Category Number of
Members
1 “Eminent Psychiatrist” from the state, not in Government Service,. 1
2 Mental Health Professional a post-graduate degree (Ayurveda) in
Mano Vigyan Avum Manas Roga or a post-graduate degree
(homoeopathy) in Psychiatry or a post graduation degree (unani) in
Moalijat (Nasfasiyatt) or a post-graduate degree (siddha) in Sirappu
Maruthuvam;
1
3 “Psychiatric Social Worker” having at least fifteen years experience in
the field.
1
4 “Clinical Psychologist” having at least fifteen years experience in the
field.
1
5 “Mental Health Nurse” having at least fifteen years experience in the
field of Mental Health.
1
6 “Persons representing persons who have or have had mental illness” 2
7 Persons representing care-givers of persons with mental illness or
organisations representing care-givers
2
8 “Persons representing Non-Governmental Organisations” which
provide services to persons with mental illness.
2
Eligibility Conditions
1. The applicant shall be an Indian National (Preferably Resident of Goa/ working in Goa)
2. The applicant shall not be of the age exceeding 67 years
3. Persons applying for categories under Sr no. 1 to 5 above shall registered with Goa State Mental
Health Authority on its constitution. An undertaking to the effect that registration will be done
with the Goa State Mental Health Authority on its constitution needs to be furnished along with
application form. (*proformma enclosed)
4. For each post candidate shall apply separately and shall clearly write on the top of the
envelope in bold letter for the applied post
Term of office, allowances etc. of non-official members of Goa State Mental Health Authority: The
Term of office allowances etc. of non-official members of Goa State Mental Health Authority will be as
per the provisions of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 and Rules. frames there under
Applications On plain paper giving details like name, Address, DOB , essential Qualification, Additional
qualification Undertaking, experience , Email ID, Cell Phone No.& any other information along with
required Certificates/Documents shall be submitted through Ordinary Post/Speed Post/by hand
Delivery to the office of Chief Executive Officer GSMHA Institute of Psychiatry and Human Behaviour
(IPHB) Bambolim Goa. The filled application giving entire details with self attested enclosed shall reach
to the office on or before 18 /10/2019
NOTE
1) On receipt of details application with enclosed all the application will be scrutinize by
scrutinizing committee notified by Government.
2) If more number of application are received for the single categories of post given, then
committee will decide the application on its merits by considering- various aspect
Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 is published in official Gazette of Goa, series 1 No 33 on 28th June 2018

V. N. SHETYE
CEO
